messages:
Maya: Quick sync: finalizing our long-term routing roadmap for multi-tenant isolation. Need concrete launch criteria and owner assignments.

Devon: Recommend phased approach: policy-only "soft" isolation first, then physical split for high-SLA customers. Minimizes infra churn.

Priya: Agree on soft-first but require deterministic eviction semantics and an explicit cost model for shared pools. Otherwise customers see unpredictable bills.

Logan: Ops constraints: telemetry must include per-tenant token burn, KV-cache hit rate, and eviction counts. We need an automated protection circuit to throttle noisy tenants before p99 degradation.

Anna: CS ask: migration playbook, rollback windows, and suggested blackout windows per region. Customers want clear expectations.

Maya: Draft launch criteria: (1) staging+prod telemetry for isolation lanes; (2) canary with 2 pilots for 21-28 days; (3) documented rollback/runbook; (4) pricing bands linked to SLA tiers.

Devon: Add an entitlement matrix mapping (free/shared/reserved/dedicated) to routing behavior and billing. Also a staging traffic-replay test at 10x peak.

Priya: Proposed SLO thresholds: p95 latency delta <=20%, p99 <=40%, KV hit rate >=90% for cached flows, eviction events <=0.3%/hour. Alert on p99 spike >2x baseline.

Logan: For canary reserve ~15% of pool capacity; create synthetic tenants to exercise cache thrash and eviction paths. I'll schedule the canary slot.

Maya: Ownership: Devon -> entitlement matrix + policy prototype (PLAT-721); Priya -> SLOs + alerts; Logan -> canary capacity + synthetic tenants; Anna -> pilot approvals + migration windows.

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window Fri 02:00-03:00 UTC. Avoid canary cutovers then.

Anna: Also note: customers usually require ~2 weeks notice for migrations. We'll coordinate communications.

Maya: One open question: rollback SLA for dedicated lanes. Proposal: 72h standard; 24h for Gold if we commit to 24/7 on-call and rehearsals.

Priya: 24h is doable only with dedicated on-call and tested runbooks. Recommend we only offer 24h in contract with added fee.

Maya: Good. I'll draft a one-page launch brief and circulate before Friday sign-off. Thanks all.
